name: @atomize-hq/figma-token-rail
description: Publish a DTCG token artifact into Figma variables, and check a Figma file for drift against it. Repo is canonical; Figma is downstream.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm smoke
scripts.smoke: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m=>{if(typeof m.flattenTokenDocument!=='function'||typeof m.syncVariablesViaRest!=='function')throw new Error('built package does not expose its API');console.log('smoke ok')})"
